claims.statement: Supademo turns recorded workflows into guided interactive demos, videos, guides, and collections.
Fast creation, basic ease, and reuse across sales, training, support, and onboarding are the strongest positive patterns.
Dynamic pages, scrolling, modals, closely spaced clicks, editing, customization, voiceover, and organization can cause trouble.
Free supports one creator and five guided demos. Scale is $38 monthly per creator. Growth is $350 monthly for five creators, with extra creators at $50 monthly.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The first walkthrough appears quick; the hard test is capturing a difficult workflow and correcting it without starting over.
scoreRationale.product: Useful for short guided product tours that are reused; less suitable when the product changes often or needs detailed editing.
scoreRationale.billing: Free is useful for a real trial; paid creator seats need careful role planning.
scoreRationale.overall: Build one difficult workflow, publish it in three places, change the product, update the demo, and verify the analytics before purchase.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Interactive steps can be clearer than video and can break when the interface changes.
Reuse saves work only when ownership and updates are managed.
Paid creator seats control cost and can leave too few editors.
